s: puM, (praTamakalpa AdyAramBaH prayojanaM yasya । “prayojanam .” 5 । 1 । 109 । iti WaY । yadvA, praTamakalpamaDIte iti । vidyAlakzaRakalpAntAcceti vaktavyamiti Wak .) praTamArabDavedADyayanaH । praTamaM SikzaRIyaM kalpaM SAstramaDIte yaH ityarTe zRikaH । tatparyyAyaH । SEkzaH 2 । ityamaraBaratO ॥
v: tri॰ praTakalpe BavaH Wak । 1 praTamAramBocite vedADyayanAdO । praTamaM kalpamaDIte kalpAntatvAt Wak । 3 praTamakalparUpaSikzAgranTADyAyini amaraH ।
m: प्राथमकल्पिक mf(ई)n. (fr. प्रथम-कल्प) being (anything) first of all or in the strictest sense of the word (v.l. for प्रथम-कपित, q.v., Mn. ix, 166)
प्राथमकल्पिक m. a student who is a beginner, L.
a Yogī just commencing his course, Sarvad. (cf. प्रथम-कल्पिक).
a: {{प्राथमकाल्पकः->प्राथमकल्पिकः||20170110||ह्त्त्प्स्:गित्हुब्.चोम्सन्स्क्रित्-लेऌइचोन्छौण्णैछ्थीऔङ्शिस्सुएस्332,|}} — 1 A student who has just entered on the study of the Vedas (शैक्ष). --2 A Yogin just commencing his course.

k.v: छात्रान्तेवासिनौ शिष्ये शैक्षाः प्राथमकल्पिकाः। एकब्रह्मव्रताचारा मिथः सब्रह्मचारिणः॥

s: tri, (praTame BavaH । praTama + WaY .) praTamaBavaH । yaTA । yatrAviralakrameRa sidDisizADayizAnumitayastatra dbitIyakzaRe pakzatAsampattyarTaM dbitIyaH sizADayizAviraho viSezaRamastu sidDeH prATamikastu kimarTam । iti pakzatASiromaRiH ॥
v: tri॰ praTame BavaH WaY । 1 praTamaBave striyAM NIp । praTamamaDIte praTama + Wak । vedAdeH 2 praTamADyetari ca ।
m: प्राथमिक mf(ई)n. (fr. प्रथम) belonging or relating to the first, occurring or happening for the first time, primary, initial, previous &c., TPrāt.; Vedāntas.; Kull.
a: प्राथमिक — a. (की f.) 1 Primary, first, initial. --2 Former, previous. --3 Happening for the first time.

s: tri, (praTama + zyaY .) praTamasya BAvaH । yaTA, “asmABireva prATamyena nAnAmunInAM vacanErevaMviDo nibanDaH kriyate .” iti vijayarakzitaH ॥
m: प्राथम्य n. priority, ĀpŚr., Sch.; Kull.
